news.title: ETF Innovators featuring Marc-André Lewis, EVP and CIO at CI Global Asset Management
news.description: Marc-André Lewis, Executive Vice President and Chief Investment Officer at CI Global Asset Management sat down with us to discuss CI’s industry leadership offering global active management solutions to Canadian investors. CI has also lead the way with one of Canada’s largest Covered Call ETF product suites and a long track record of providing Liquid Alternative strategies via an ETF structure as well. Watch the full conversation to learn more.
news.tags: Assets, Canadian Banks, ETFs, ETF, CI, CI Investments, Covered Calls

news.title: ETF Innovators featuring Som Seif, CEO, Purpose Investments
